t: What Ibn az-Zubayr said after every prayer
a: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ
p: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-Llāh. Lā ilāha illā-Llāh, lā naʿbudu illā iyyāh, lahu-n-niʿmah
m: There is no power and no strength except with Allah. There is no god but Allah. We worship none but Him. To Him belongs every favour.
